verdict.rationale: CrewAI's core architecture is explicitly built for multi-agent orchestration: Crews coordinate collaborative agents with sequential/hierarchical processes, Flows enable structured event-driven workflows combining multiple tasks and Crews, and tools support delegation among agent 'coworkers'. Community evidence (HN Show HN post) confirms real-world use building multi-agent workflows, though one competitor notes CrewAI lacks certain deterministic pause/guardrail hooks compared to alternatives.
